correctness.rationale: The quota-respecting inverted-pair prohibition restricts 20 three-up outcomes to exactly seven: (1,1,1) or six permutations of (2,1,0). In the latter, off-diagonal 3-by-3 transport supplies l_i and demands 1-h_i with total S; Hall/mincut reduces exactly to S<=1 and l_i+1-h_i<=S. One 6-cycle permits edge cancellation and a support at most 6; for rational witness l=(3,7,12)/40, 1-h=(8,8,6)/40, six edge weights (1,2,3,4,5,7)/40, z=18/40, the one-dimensional margin polytope t in [-2,1] forces at least five edge types + z. Symmetric p threshold 2/3. Independent 7-outcome brute force and rational margin check carried out; source exact max-flow checker read. Conditions assume within-pair distinct residues.
